thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v2026.04.12 (canary -> prod) on cluster-7. rolling out model: rdlw/galena-3-small:version-7

deploy-bot: Canary group A (traffic 2%) healthy initially, canary group B failing healthchecks: 5xx and corrupted token output. logs: `tokenizer mismatch: expected vocab_size 50257 got 50258`

mia: paging oncall, looks like a tokenizer/weights mismatch. can someone take? :exclamation:

incident-bot: Paging on-call: mia (primary) -> sam (secondary). Incident created: INC-2026-0412-01. Severity: high.

mia: i'm on it. grabbing logs from canary host-12 now.

sam: acked. brb, finishing lunch. can you paste the failing payloads?

oliver: stack traces show new weight bundle references tokenizer v2.1 while runtime expects v2.0. suspect packaging script pointed at wrong tokenizer artifact.

nina: customer impact: initial telemetry shows ~0.6% of requests returned garbled outputs (weird unicode/placement tokens) and ~0.1% 500s. Most errors in EU region. Not yet escalated by customers but support queue holding a few repros.

mia: i'm switching canary routing to degrade traffic to 0% while we triage. doing feature-flag kill now.

mia: /ff toggle model-serving.canary-route --value false --actor mia

deploy-bot: Feature flag update recorded. Canary traffic redirected to stable. New requests landing on previous model: rdlw/galena-3-small:version-6

sam: confirm canary traffic drained. seeing drop in error rate now. nice.

mia: good. we need a rollback and root cause. oliver, can we roll weights back to version-6 across cluster-7? or is there config drift?

oliver: we can force a rollforward to stable model image. but build system pushed tokenizer v2.1 into the weights bundle registry under tag `version-7` by mistake. registry metadata mismatch.

sam: is there any lingering KV cache or prefix that would cause mismatches once we redeploy?

oliver: KV caches keyed by model id + tokenizer hash. because the tokenizer hash stored in metadata for version-7 is v2.1, older runtime v2.0 sees mismatch on load and throws. caches are not the issue; binary artifacts are mismatched.

nina: recommend rollback to version-6 and run a verification job for tokenizer/weights parity. notify enterprise customers in EU about brief impact?

mia: agreed. rolling rollback now. command: 

```
# rollback to stable
rdctl deploy set-model --cluster cluster-7 --model rdlw/galena-3-small:version-6 --force --reason "canary tokenizer mismatch"
```

mia: initiating.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for cluster-7 -> target model version-6. Jobs scheduled: 12 pods to replace. ETA ~3m.

sam: i'll watch the takeover and healthchecks. setting a short canary after rollback to validate tokenization end-to-end.

(2m pass)

oliver: healthchecks green on 9/12 pods, 3 still initializing. logs show tokenizer v2.0 loaded correctly.

mia: error rate trending back down to baseline. customer repros returning normal outputs.

nina: support banner prepared: "We observed a brief degradation affecting tokenization for a subset of requests in EU. Traffic was reverted to a stable model and full service restored. If you see issues, contact support." Ready to send on your go.

sam: hold on communications until we validate post-rollback metrics for 15m.

oliver: created hotfix checklist: 1) audit registry artifact tagging 2) verify packaging script does not pull latest tokenizer unless explicitly specified 3) add pre-deploy parity check (weights <-> tokenizer) 4) add metadata checksum enforcement in runtime.

mia: i'm handing off to sam to own the postmortem and customer follow-up. sam, you're oncall for the next 2 hours?

sam: yep, taking handoff. i'll write incident summary and immediate action items. adding owners: oliver (runtime), nina (comms), me (postmortem).

incident-bot: On-call handover: mia -> sam. Handoff note: canary routing disabled, rollback completed, monitor for 60m for regressions.

nina: after 15m of stable metrics, i'll send the support banner and a short note to EU sales.

sam: initial customer impact assessment: scope ~0.6% requests in EU, duration ~8m (start to rollback). No major data leaks, just malformed outputs and small % 500s. Severity: S2 (customer-visible but degraded for short window).

mia: filing initial triage ticket: INC-2026-0412-01-T1 with logs attached and reproducer.

oliver: pushing quick CI gate to prevent future mismatches: adding a pre-release job that verifies tokenizer hash in model artifact matches runtime expectations. will PR in 30m.

sam: next steps (short): 1) finalize rollback verification (me) 2) comms after 15m stable (nina) 3) fix artifact tagging + CI gate (oliver) 4) full postmortem within 72h (sam)

nina: thanks team. i'll stand by for the go for comms. :thumbsup:

mia: great job everyone. closing the active pager.

incident-bot: Pager resolved: all pages cleared for INC-2026-0412-01.

sam: taking the rest of the thread into the postmortem doc. will ping if anything pops.

oliver: will follow up PR soon.

nina: sending comms now that metrics held for 20m. support banner posted.

sam: marking incident as mitigated. will update severity in the postmortem if needed.
